title: feat: add Pollen spend by category KPI and graph
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a switchable Pollen-spend KPI for text, image, video, audio, realtime, embeddings, 3D, community, and tools/other; includes CSV export.
- Adds a completed-week graph: top three regular categories by latest week, or one selected category. Community spend stays separate.
- Reuses the existing weekly usage endpoint and chart. Counts successful billed final requests (Paid + Quest), not Stripe cash revenue or provider costs; video takes priority over soundtrack audio. Shows a decline to zero as -100%.
- Verified: 41 tests, production build, browser chart/selector check, and 16 read-only SQL fixtures. Live weekly category totals reconcile with Paid + Quest spend.
- Rollout: deploy the updated Tinybird pipe to staging first, verify, then production before the dashboard. No deployments performed in this PR.

gist.headline: Where the Pollen Went
gist.blurb: The hive dashboard can now sort its Pollen crumbs by what made them. Text, images, video, and the rest each get their own little trail through the garden.
gist.summary: Added switchable Pollen-spend KPIs, CSV export, and completed-week charts for text, image, video, audio, realtime, embeddings, 3D, community, and tools/other, using successful billed final Paid and Quest requests from the existing weekly usage endpoint.
gist.impact: Operators can now inspect the top three regular spend categories or a selected category by week, with community spend kept separate and video correctly taking priority over soundtrack audio.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy observability garden where Polli, wearing tiny analyst glasses, studies a retro CRT dashboard showing different Pollen jars and a gentle weekly chart. Color-coded code-plants represent text, image, video, audio, embeddings, 3D, community, and tools, while a separate community flower bed makes the categorization visible.
